name: Conneaut Industries Inc
old_description: Founded in 1930, Conneaut Industries is a fourth- generation lead company. Conneaut products provide value added contribution for our customers. Conneaut products are found in a vast array of global markets and applications.
about:
Conneaut Industries has operated from West Greenwich, Rhode Island since its founding in 1930. The company remains family-owned and operated, now in its fourth generation, and describes itself as a "fourth-generation lead company" that has maintained continuous operations for over nine decades. No individual founders are named in public materials.

The firm specializes in textile converting, positioned between raw material manufacturers and end-use producers. Its core processes include precision winding, twisting, plying, cabling, and filler production. Conneaut works with a range of fibers such as fiberglass, aramids, cotton, polyester, nylon, PTFE-coated fiberglass, ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene (UHMWPE), S2-glass, PTFE yarn, and meta-aramids. It supplies these materials on various package types including cardboard tubes, wood reels, plastic serving spools, and industry-standard bobbins. Facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Conneaut serves markets including aerospace, automotive, food processing, industrial, medical, oil and gas, sports and recreation, telecommunications, and durable goods. Specific applications cited by the company include electrical wire and cable, electronics, aerospace components, fiber optics, composite materials, ignition wire cores, magnet wire covering, braiding, weaving, knitting, and cordage.

The company emphasizes its nine-decade track record, a loyal low-turnover workforce, and a quality policy focused on continuous improvement and customer fulfillment. It holds ISO 9001:2015 certification and states that its globally sourced products are REACH and RoHS compliant and conflict-minerals free. Its stated mission is to be the best specialty yarn converter in the world.
